describes: Current grouping/ungrouping and atomic Caret + StrikeOut changes.

cases.name: a-pair-groups
cases.covers: A pair groups with one relationship patch; selection stays group-aware.

cases.name: group-and-ungroup
cases.covers: Grouping needs two changeable records on one page; grouping and ungrouping each write all subordinate patches in one atomic Change.

cases.name: group-refused-per-record
cases.covers: Per-record update authority disables grouping and ungrouping while direct writes rely on engine refusal; a separately permitted selection reaches an intended atomic engine refusal.

cases.name: replace-text-creates-a-group
cases.covers: One Change creates the Caret primary and StrikeOut subordinate under stable born refs; both stay selected.

cases.name: replace-text-refusal-is-atomic
cases.covers: An engine refusal removes both pending parts together; no compensation delete runs. A held refused primary change clears both parts; the host route lets the engine refuse an unknown page.
